rationale: Banking/finance desk of a national business daily with deal-level acquiring and terminal coverage; standalone monitorable section.
ICT trade hub with a standing series on state IT contract awards plus BankID/e-banking coverage.
Dedicated public-procurement daily with ministry tender pipelines and UOHS rulings; highest A2 signal density.
Business weekly useful for tender-design scrutiny but access status unknown and volume low; re-check reachability.
IT-business news naming winning vendors and contract values on large state systems.
Only dedicated Czech banking trade monthly; likely subscription/registration gate to clear before monitoring.
Transport trade media reporting ticketing/fare-collection tenders with suppliers and values; EMV transit payments channel.
Author page of a larger portal, but a stable investigative feed on contested IT contracts; monitor as sub-feed of seznamzpravy.cz.
Subscription investigative daily with named-actor procurement detail; paywall must be cleared.
Free public-service newsroom with per-bank tag pages; url_verification failed, re-check liveness before approval.
National agency free wire — earliest citable timestamp for award announcements.
Retail trade monthly covering merchant payment acceptance and POS deployment — demand side of acquiring.
Logistics trade with only incidental self-service payment hardware content; low tender density.
Commercial ICT price-benchmark vendor derived from procurement data; commercial terms/licence must be cleared.
NGO case index pointing to underlying tenders and actors; mine for leads then archive.
Enterprise-IT monthly with banking-transformation features; value moderate and access unknown.
OCCRP partner useful for beneficial-ownership and AML checks on bidders; low volume.
Economics section of the public broadcaster site; free corroboration layer for award values and winners.
High-volume regional daily, largely derivative; some municipal ticketing/payments tenders but noisy.
National open-data catalogue (DCAT-AP) — master index enabling enumeration of all procurement datasets and their API/CSV endpoints.
MMR analytical layer over VVZ with monthly OpenData bulk XML/CSV — cleanest historic award series.
Statutory contract register bulk dumps giving incumbent identity, value and expiry — the core re-tender trigger.
Documented ISRS API for near-real-time incremental detection of new banking/payments contracts.
EU-level TED aggregation with curated CSV history; useful backbone though CZ coverage only via TED layer.
Commercial normalised tender/supplier database with API; requires licensing and credentials.
Aggregator of contracting-authority profiles — good for locating and snowballing into profile URLs.
